narrative.overview: This is the station's broadcast ledger, made public: one canonical page per artist, a month archive instead of numbered pages, and a playlist sheet whose hour spine keeps a 385-track day navigable. It inherits the host theme's typeface and takes one station accent; the only dark object is the broadcast plate.
keyCharacteristics: One canonical page per artist; tracks are sections on it, not thin pages.
Month archive and hour anchors replace numeric pagination.
Tabular numerals for every time, count and duration.
The accent is spent on links, the local badge, the now marker and current state, never on large surfaces.
Flat surfaces and hairlines; no shadows, gradients, glass or webfonts.
Server-rendered HTML with no nonce or per-visitor state, safe for a full-page cache.
No eyebrow/kicker layer above headings; the heading carries its own context.

rules.name: The Single Canonical Artist Rule
rules.body: Every artist has one indexable page that carries all airplay; do not split an artist over track pages or repeat the entity on playlists.

rules.name: The Dark Plate Rule
rules.body: Only the broadcast plate is dark. The page stays light so the plugin reads as part of the station's site, not as a media app pasted into it.

rules.name: The Accent-As-Signal Rule
rules.body: The station accent marks links, the local badge, the now marker and current state. It never fills large regions and never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every time, duration, count and date uses tabular numerals and stays on one optical column.

dos: Do keep the host theme's title, breadcrumb, sidebar and advertising on playlist pages.
Do keep the month archive and the hour anchors; they are the navigation.
Do derive accent companions and verify AA on white and on the 9% tint.
Do keep the table semantic: caption, column scopes, real time elements.
Do keep the page complete without JavaScript.
Do keep the HTML identical for every visitor so the full-page cache can serve it.
donts: Don't add numeric pagination, offset links or a card grid of playlists.
Don't add a second brand colour, a webfont, an icon font or a station name in the source.
Don't hide the programme name, the date or the current track behind an interaction.
Don't convey local, current or selected state with colour alone.
Don't add shadows, gradients, glass or decorative corner cuts.
Don't render tracks only client-side or depend on a JavaScript framework.
